title: Pushkin Visual & Narrative Anchor Schema V1
description: Schema for reusable visual and narrative reference anchors in Pushkin Visual Pattern Library. Anchors capture artistic patterns (composition, environment, characters, actions, decor, atmosphere, narrative potential) without asserting historical factuality.

anchor_id.description: Unique identifier for the visual anchor (e.g., VA-CRIMEA-PROMENADE-001).

anchor_name.description: Human-readable title of the visual anchor.

anchor_category.description: Composite pattern classification (e.g., ENVIRONMENT + CHARACTER + COMPOSITION).

library_categories.description: Filterable categories in the Visual Library UI.

literary_space.description: Extensible cultural/geographical/literary context (e.g., 'Крым и Таврида', 'Бахчисарай', 'Михайловское', 'Петербург'). Allows expansion beyond Crimea.

source_image.description: Relative public path or URI to the original preserved asset.

source_type.description: Origin classification (e.g., 'Современная ИИ-стилизованная иллюстрация', 'Стилизованная почтовая открытка', 'Историческая гравюра').

visual_description.description: Factual description of what is depicted in the visual reference.

composition_features.description: Structural layout patterns (e.g., 'Центральная фигура', 'Многочастная открытка', 'Панорамный пейзаж').

character_features.description: Role-based character archetypes without claiming documentary identity from facial likeness.

decorative_features.description: Ornamental frames, botanical motifs, vignettes, calligraphy.

narrative_potential.description: Possible literary motifs and story directions inspired by the scene.

generation_guidance.description: Practical guidance for using this anchor in visual prompt synthesis or poetic inspiration.

related_anchors.description: IDs of related anchors forming thematic or compositional series.

motif_keywords.description: Russian stem/motif tokens used for transparent poem-to-anchor matching in Mode 2.

confidence.description: Cataloging confidence based on direct visual inspection.

historical_status.description: Explicit note distinguishing artistic/AI stylization from documentary historical evidence.

processing_status.description: Actual file inspection and processing state.
